setlist.title: It Must Have Been the Roses

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Crazy Fingers** (6 reviews): Runs about fifteen minutes; Version brings out especially mournful vocals from Jerry [5][7][9][10][13][14]
- **Scarlet Begonias *(SBD only)** (2 reviews): Singled out as a great Scarlet; Nice jamming in Scarlet, and also in Saint Stephen [11][12]
- **Not Fade Away** (2 reviews): Wharf Rat sits in the middle of the Saint Stephen/Not Fade Away medley, with odd tonal tangents in NFA; Extended wandering before the NFA starts is the second set highlight [5][7]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Reviewer's favorite: a beautiful version [13]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Rare Morning Dew as the encore [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Morning Dew **(MTX**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-09-30.137537.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 173 min; rated 3.2/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd76-09-30.fob-patched.unknown.11939.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 171 min; rated 3.5/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audience recording's sound good, better than expected [5]
- **gd1976-09-30.sbd.gans-cribbs.30225.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 113 min; rated 3/5 by 10 [3]
- **gd1976-09-30.sbd.18107.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 56 min; rated 3.73/5 by 15 [4]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sounds cozy, though cleaner boards exist; Soundboard sounds a bit iffy in places; A few sound glitches [7][9][14]

## Around the show

- Show was originally scheduled for Mershon but moved to St. John Arena, a roughly 12,000-seat basketball arena, per this reviewer [8]
- Booked for a larger hall, but weak ticket sales moved it to Mershon, with general admission seating [15]
- Reviewer attended the show; early Deadbase listed only a partial setlist [15]
- Not the best show of the year, but holds up well among thirty years of shows [14]
- Covers only part of the show, with no second disc; Charlie Miller's seed supplies that material [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-09-30.137537.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 3 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:030225+018107), Disc 1 & 3 [1]. Also: Matrix recording, credited to dusborne, distributed as FLAC 16-bit [1]
- **gd76-09-30.fob-patched.unknown.11939.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [2]. Also: Audience master cassette to cassette to DAT to CD, via Jonathan Miller, seeded to etree by Dave Backus; Scarlet Begonias is patched in from a soundboard master reel [2]
- **gd1976-09-30.sbd.gans-cribbs.30225.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Andy Lemieux and Sean Cribbs; source: SBD>MR>DAT>CD [3]. Also: Soundboard lineage: master reel to DAT to CD to EAC to SHN, from Gans source discs via Andy Lemieux [3]
- **gd1976-09-30.sbd.18107.shnf**: transferred by Andy Lemieux, Sean Ribss, Charlie Miller; source: SBD>Rm>Dat>Sonic Solutions>CD [4]. Also: Partial soundboard: reel to DAT to Sonic Solutions to CD to EAC to SHN, via Charlie Miller [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead of the Day: [September 30, 1976](https://gratefuldeadoftheday.com/09-30-1976/) [21]
